definitionZh: 文本装饰-设置 CSS 属性可以调整元素文本装饰的起始点和结尾点,从而可以缩短、加长或改变其对已渲染文本的立场。
sourceDefinition: The text-decoration-inset CSS property enables adjusting the start and end points of an element's text decoration so it can be shortened, lengthened, or have its position shifted with respect to the rendered text.
